name: Transcript LOL
description:
Transcript LOL turns audio and video into accurate, speaker-labelled transcripts — meetings, customer calls, interviews, podcasts, lectures and more, in dozens of languages. This connector gives Claude OAuth-scoped access to your Transcript.lol workspaces so you can work with your recordings without leaving the conversation.

What Claude can do with it:
• Find recordings by what was said — semantic or exact search across every transcript, filtered by folder, speaker or date, with timestamps for each hit.
• Read transcripts and translations — the full text, a specific time window, or SRT/VTT/JSON with timestamps.
• Reuse existing AI insights — pull summaries, action items, key points and any custom prompt output already generated, or run one of your workspace's prompt templates to generate a new insight.
• Start new work — submit a public audio/video URL for transcription, or request a translation into another language, then poll until it's ready.
• Keep the library organised — rename recordings, create and rename folders, move recordings, and label diarized speakers with named people.

Example prompts:
• "Summarise yesterday's customer call and list the action items."
• "Find the meeting where we discussed pricing and quote the exact wording."
• "Pull the key decisions from every interview in the Q3 Research folder."
• "Transcribe this podcast episode and give me the five main takeaways."

Every tool runs under the connected user's own permissions: Claude only sees the workspaces and recordings that account can already access, and read-only tools are annotated so Claude can browse safely. Requires a Transcript.lol plan with API access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Transcript LOL to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Transcript LOL to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://transcript.lol/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Transcript LOL MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transcript LOL lists 23 MCP tools, including assign_speaker, create_folder, create_prompt, create_speaker, generate_insight, get_insights, get_recording, get_transcript, get_translation, list_folders, list_prompts, and list_recordings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Transcript LOL?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Transcript LOL in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Transcript LOL MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transcript LOL requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Transcript LOL is developed by Omnivision. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
